Free Space Intent
Advertiser: Free Space Intent Pte Ltd
Started: 16 Apr 2026
A vibrant tapestry of personal style, this HDB terrace was
carefully curated to showcase the homeowner's diverse
passions, from music and books to a stunning crystal
collection. Housing just two bedrooms, the interior takes on a
captivating Spanish theme, with a lively interplay of bright
orange and yellow hues that grace both the living and kitchen
spaces. An extension was thoughtfully incorporated into the
smaller bathroom upstairs, transforming it into a spacious
haven complete with a bathtub. Retaining key architectural
elements, including the front bifold doors and the arch window
in the kitchen, anchors the design in authenticity. The
imperfections are integral to the soulful charm that defines
every corner of this Spanish-themed HDB terrace. 💬 Let’s
create your dream home! Book a complimentary design
consultation with us now #linkinbio #FreeSpaceIntent
